description: A cool luminous network of branching answers stops at a threshold before a warm empty chair and a compass, representing the boundary between machine output and human responsibility.
prompt: Create an original 16:9 conceptual editorial cover illustration for an essay titled ‘A Machine Can Answer You. Sophisticated magazine editorial art, restrained, contemplative, tactile paper texture, strong depth and clean composition, cinematic 16:9 landscape.
